name: Mitten Extracts Moonrocks | OG Kush
description: A legendary profile elevated to the next level, OG Kush Moon Rocks deliver classic earthy, pine-forward flavor with deep, powerful effects. The infused flower and kief coating amplify this iconic strain into a heavy-hitting experience.
